proposals.evidence: Full gorasa explicitly gives Oriya gorasa milk/buttermilk and Bihari/Maithili goras milk/curds, with broader regional milk-product senses. These support eastern gorəs/goṛəs/goros milk forms. Source rhotic quality and vowels remain unchanged; the unqualified milk gloss is preserved, with local development and cross-IA transmission qualified. Exact response: goṛəs.
